title: fix(spec): the report panel's English rows read in business terms
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9Gqqp1VYZwEqbXEm1YsTjU)_
Part of #36447
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 报表设计器右侧属性面板在英文界面下，排序、联合分块、筛选与图表、时间段与导出这几处的说明文字改成业务用语（数据来源、分组、指标），与中文面板说法一致；"排序"一栏改名为"Sort order"。
- 属于"报表与仪表盘面板说业务话"这项体验工作的英文收尾，替用英文界面搭报表的业务管理员解决看不懂开发术语的问题。
- 只改了说明文字，不改任何可保存的设置；出错最多是某句提示读起来别扭，直接撤回即可。
- 请决定：被翻译决策记录钉住、或需要新增表单行的其余几处英文提示，是否放宽本卡的改动范围由本卡收尾（详见下方遗留清单）。

## What changes

The report authoring form (`packages/spec/src/ui/report.form.ts`) is the producer of the English rows the console's report panel draws below its curated controls. Per the seat route (producer-first, no `en` overlay, no section-title rename), this PR rewords the rows it can reword inside the claimed file surface, in the business vocabulary the zh-CN rows already use (data source, grouping, metric), and regenerates the platform's English metadata-form bundle from it.

**Measured premise corrections**

- The dashboard **widget** panel (`DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx`) draws **zero** rows from spec text: it renders no spec form. Every row label and hint there is a console string from the studio i18n namespace (`engine.inspector.widget.*`), and those already read "Data source", "Group by", "Metrics" in English, matching zh-CN. Nothing to change for the widget panel.
- The rows were enumerated by rendering `ReportDefaultInspector` in English for a summary, a matrix and a joined report with every collapsible section open, on base 4c93f880.

**Row table — every English row the report panel draws from spec text** (lines on base 4c93f880)

| Row | Source | Before | After |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Section "Basics", description | report.form.ts:24 | Identity and report type. | unchanged (same meaning as zh-CN) |
| Description, hint | i18n.zod.ts:275 (`I18nLabelSchema` describe, no form helpText) | Display label — the default-language string, or an inline locale map ({ en, "zh-CN" }) resolved at render time | **left over** (see below) |
| Section "Dataset binding", label | report.form.ts:34 | Dataset binding | **left over** (slugged section key) |
| Section "Dataset binding", description | report.form.ts:35 | The semantic-layer dataset this report renders. Values are the dataset’s measures; rows are its dimensions. | **left over** (ledger pin) |
| Order, label | prettified, no form label | Order | Sort order |
| Order, hint | report.form.ts:51 | Sort keys, most significant first (a rows/columns dimension or a values measure). Time dimensions are chronological by default. | What to sort by, most important first (a grouping or a metric). Time groupings sort in date order by default. |
| Order rows, "Order By" | report.form.ts:57 = report.zod.ts:107 title | Order By | **left over** (title equality pin) |
| Drilldown, hint | report.form.ts:61 | Click an aggregated row/cell to open the underlying records | **left over** (ledger pin; readable) |
| Section "Joined blocks", label | report.form.ts:65 | Joined blocks | **left over** (slugged section key) |
| Section "Joined blocks", description | report.form.ts:66 | Additional dataset-bound blocks stacked into a single report (joined reports only). | Other blocks stacked into the same report, each with its own data source (joined reports only). |
| Blocks, hint | report.form.ts:72 | Dataset-bound sub-reports (joined report only) | Sub-reports, each with its own data source (joined reports only). |
| Blocks rows "Dataset", "Rows", "Columns", "Values" | report.form.ts:89-92 = `JoinedReportBlockSchema` titles | Dataset / Rows / Columns / Values | **left over** (title equality pin) |
| Section "Filter & chart", description | report.form.ts:101 | Render-time scope filter and chart presentation. | Filter conditions and how the chart is shown. |
| Runtime Filter, hint | report.form.ts:105 | Render-time scope filter, ANDed at query time | **left over** (ledger pin) |
| Date Range, hint | report.form.ts:122 | Default period and custom-range switch. The dimension must be a date dimension of the dataset; leave it empty when the dataset has exactly one. | The default period, and whether people may choose their own range. It applies to one date grouping of the data source, which can stay empty when the data source has only one. |
| Date Range children (Dimension, Default Range, Allow Custom Range) | report.zod.ts:702-705 describes (no form rows) | e.g. Dataset dimension (declared `type: 'date'`) the window applies to; omitted = the dataset's one date dimension | **left over** (no form row) |
| Export Options, hint | report.form.ts:123 | Download formats (csv, xlsx) and file name. Who may download is the export permission on the dataset object. | Download formats (csv, xlsx) and file name. Who may download is set by the export permission on the data source’s object. |
| Export Options children (Formats, Include Headers, File Name Prefix) | list-view-export-options.ts:195-198 describes (no form rows) | e.g. Formats the report's export control offers (default: ['csv', 'xlsx']); an empty list turns the control off | **left over** (no form row) |

Rows the panel does not draw (its curated controls replace them; the server-served form still renders them):

| Row | Source | Before | After |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Type, hint | report.form.ts:30 | Report type: tabular/summary/matrix/joined | Report type: tabular, summary, matrix or joined. |
| Columns, hint | report.form.ts:43 | Dimension names across (matrix only) | Groups spread across the columns (matrix reports only). |
| Chart, hint | report.form.ts:108 | Chart config (type, legend, colors) | Chart type and settings. |
| Dataset / Values / Rows, hints | report.form.ts:39-41 | Dataset to bind (…) / Measure names (…) / Dimension names (…) | **left over** (ledger pin) |

**Left over — why each row stops here**

- *Slugged section labels* ("Dataset binding", "Joined blocks"): renaming moves the `dataset_binding` / `joined_blocks` keys of the zh overlay and of every `metadataForms` catalog. Not renamed, per the seat route.
- *Ledger pins*: `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/report-form-echo-decisions.test.ts` holds the `en` source of the Dataset binding description, the Drilldown hint and the Runtime Filter hint equal to the live bundle, and `report-dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` does the same for the Dataset / Values / Rows hints. Each row records ja-JP / es-ES translation verdicts judged against that English. Rewording them means editing those ledgers, which is outside this card's claimed file surface.
- *Title equality pins* (Order By; blocks Dataset / Rows / Columns / Values): each repeater row label must equal its item schema's `.meta({ title })` in `report.zod.ts`, outside the claimed surface.
- *No form row* (Description hint; Date Range and Export Options children): the panel shows the schema `.describe()` text because the form declares no row. A form-level fix declares the composites' children (the view-form precedent) and gives Description its own helpText, which adds new catalog leaves and moves the report-form ledger's population count; a describe-level fix edits `report.zod.ts`, `i18n.zod.ts` and the export-options describes shared with list views. Both are outside the claimed surface.

The card stays open (`Part of`) until the seat decides on those rows.

## Tests

<details><summary>Spec form, platform translation ledgers, console inspector tests — all green at 48ab16dfc</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over `src/ui/report.test.ts`, `src/ui/report-date-range-export.test.ts`, `src/ui/report-joined-block-dataset.test.ts`, `src/ui/joined-report-block-type.test.ts`, `src/kernel/repeater-item-titles.test.ts`, `src/system/metadata-form-declared-rows.pin.test.ts`, `src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts`, `scripts/schema-index.test.ts`: Test Files 8 passed (8), Tests 761 passed (761).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/apps/translations/`: Test Files 26 passed (26), Tests 610 passed (610). This includes both echo-decision ledgers, which stay green because none of their pinned rows moved.
- From `ui/`: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over every `ReportDefaultInspector*`, `DashboardWidgetInspector*` and `DashboardDefaultInspector*` test plus `report-schema.test.ts` and `metadata-form-i18n.test.ts`: Test Files 14 passed (14), Tests 122 passed (122).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card's acceptance line is **not yet met**: the left-over rows above, the Dataset binding description and the Date Range "Dimension" hint in particular, still read as schema-author text in English. This PR closes the rows inside the claimed surface.
- The zh-CN panel shows the same English `.describe()` text for the Date Range and Export Options children (no zh row exists for them, since the form declares none). Measured by the same render in zh.
- The dashboard **default** panel (`dashboardForm`, not the widget panel) has English rows of the same kind, e.g. the `gap` hint "Space between widgets, in steps of 0.25rem (4 = 1rem)" and an "Advanced" section described as "Accessibility and performance tuning." with no fields. Not in this card's ruled surface.
- Open draft PRs #36525 and #36802 also regenerate `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts`; `overlap-check` merges both cleanly. The generated file is `merge=os-regen`, so whichever lands second regenerates.

## Verification

First read, by risk: `packages/spec/src/ui/report.form.ts` (the only hand-written change); `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.metadata-forms.generated.ts` (regenerated, should mirror the form exactly).

Two-minute check: open a summary report in the Studio with the console in English and expand "Period & export". The Date Range hint reads "The default period, and whether people may choose their own range. …"; the Order field is labelled "Sort order".

<details><summary>Local gates at 48ab16dfc (exit codes captured before any pipe)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 0, "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date" (check:docs and check:authorable-surface included; prose-only, nothing regenerated).
- `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --filter=platform-objects`: exit 0 after `--write` regenerated the English bundle (the only bundle that moved).
- `pnpm check:i18n-stale-fill`: exit 0. `pnpm check:nul-bytes`: exit 0. `pnpm check:doc-authoring`: exit 0. `pnpm check:issue-citations`: exit 0. `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0. `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs`: exit 0. `pnpm check:keyed-text-bounds`: exit 0. `node scripts/docs-audit/check-affected-docs.mjs`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: VERDICT clean.
- Declared narrowing: `dispatch-gates --ran` reports 73 of 81 derived families not run locally; the full farm is CI's.

</details>
